q01.question: What are the core retail jewellery brands operated by Titan Company Limited in India?
q01.answer: Titan Company Limited operates four core retail jewellery brands in India: Tanishq, Zoya, Mia by Tanishq, and CaratLane. [https://www.titancompany.in/sites/default/files/2024-06/Titan%20Annual%20Report%202023-24%20-%2021MB%203.pdf] Tanishq is the flagship brand of Titan Company's jewellery division. [https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/titan-company-to-expand-jewellery-market-share-grow-emerging-businesses-11717313255735.html] Zoya is positioned as a premium, luxury brand within the Titan portfolio. [https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/corporate/TITAN_31052024112612_SEinvestorpresentation2024.pdf] Mia by Tanishq is focused on the lightweight jewellery segment. [https://www.livemint.com/companies/news/titan-company-to-expand-jewellery-market-share-grow-emerging-businesses-11717313255735.html] Titan Company Limited holds a majority stake in CaratLane, which operates as an omni-channel jewellery retailer. [https://www.reuters.com/markets/deals/indias-titan-co-raise-stake-its-subsidiary-caratlane-2023-08-19]

claims.text: Titan Company Limited operates four core retail jewellery brands in India: Tanishq, Zoya, Mia by Tanishq, and CaratLane.
Tanishq is the flagship brand of Titan Company's jewellery division.
Zoya is positioned as a premium, luxury brand within the Titan portfolio.
Mia by Tanishq is focused on the lightweight jewellery segment.
Titan Company Limited holds a majority stake in CaratLane, which operates as an omni-channel jewellery retailer.
